model_selection: three-fold question-disjoint cross-validation inside train; no test IO
candidate_configurations: 8 individual seed models plus 4 two-seed mean-logit ensembles
selection_ties: prefer fewer inference members, then fixed plan order
gpu: single local NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU
inference: CPU NumPy only; <=16 MiB required assets and <=30 s complete prediction plus scoring
promotion_gate: OOF accuracy >= original OOF accuracy + 0.005 and validation accuracy >= 736/798; no changes based on test outcomes
test_policy: No public test access during search. Only a gate-passing frozen method is eligible for a final score. No test-based configuration selection.
